page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.l: omnibus æqualiter dicunto ex legibus patriis.
Si in eo negligent, aut facere non volent of-
ficium suum, Hovetmanni Groningani
compellantor, iisque sub pœnâ primum scu-
tatorum x, deinde xx, postremò contumaciæ
mandanto, ut jus petentibus expediant: mul-
taque huiusmodi ex semisse civitatis, reli-
quum Reip. Vpsteranæ esto. Electus prætor
aut judex munus annuum non recusato, aut
x scutatos Reip. pendito. Prætor judicesque
sententiam à se latam petentibus scriptam ex-
hibento.
Ab hac appellandi jus esto, si quis
volet, ad Hovetmannos Groninganos intra
diem decimum.
Quo rite facto, prior judex
non procedito longius: causa refertor ad con-
ventum juredicialem proximum in urbe.
Appellans verò si non persequetur litem in
proximo, aut saltem altero conventu,
non solum lite cadito, sed etiam marcas quinque
multam solvito: nisi forte judex, qui sen-
tentiam tulit, ad conventum ipse non veniat: hoc
enim appellantem à pœnâ absolvet,
judex verò emansitans pœnam pendito. Idem ju-
dex & appellans quinas marcas deponunto
apud conventum, amittitoque depositum,
qui succumbet, victor recipito. Signatum foe-

page.notes: The paragraph division is inferred: the printed lines carry no clear indents, so I split before the marked sentences "Ab hac", "Quo rite" and "Appellans", where a leading mark stands. The mark before "Ab hac", "Quo rite" and "Appellans" is a printed ornament, not text, and is not transcribed. The running head and the long-s letters in "Fris." and "Amas." are read from the scan. The page ends on the hyphenated "foe-" and continues on the next page with the catchword "dus".
